summary: Register Threads API as a Social Core provider with exact user binding, text/image/video publishing, Task-088 media staging and provider-local short/long-lived token rotation without Core or frozen SDK-root changes.

impacts.evidence: One tenant-bound Account resolves one exact Threads user ID plus a separate app-secret reference; health, publish, status and token rotation cannot override that identity.
Threads user/app-secret and replacement token bytes remain callback/sink scoped; media is Task-088 revalidated and only short-lived staged HTTPS URLs cross to Meta.
Task 044 adds no public TORGNEXA HTTP/OpenAPI operation.
Task 044 consumes existing SocialPublisher/StatusReader and adds only provider-local TokenSink lifecycle types; frozen Connector/Runtime SDK-v1 roots and Core remain unchanged.
No migration is added. Token rotation targets the existing opaque secret reference through a host-owned sink.

Egress authority is fixed to graph.threads.net; user/app secrets use Task-021 boundaries; returned replacement tokens are validated, rotated through TokenSink, zeroed and never returned as result data.
Only text/image/video publication is declared; replies, insights, delete and other remote controls remain outside Task-044 admission.
Task-020 remains canonical publication/audit owner; provider results expose bounded remote IDs/status and token lifecycle timestamps only.
Remote IDs are exact-user bound; ambiguous writes fail closed. Token rotation preserves the opaque secret reference rather than creating provider-local durable credential state.
Outbound API authority is graph.threads.net and host-owned staged media URLs are provider inputs; no webhook surface is added.
Auth, permission, rate-limit, media-processing and remote failures are normalized; token bodies, app secret and signed media URLs are excluded from errors/results.
Suspend the Threads connector account and revoke OAuth/app credentials to stop publication/token rotation; no schema rollback is required.

Deterministic tests cover capabilities, exact account binding, Task-088 staging, content limits, token exchange/refresh grants, host secret rotation and write ambiguity; Task-064 passes all thirteen checks.
